note: Institutions in INC's 2026-27 suitability list, plus those that appear only in the 2025-26 list (their intake is recorded against 2025-26). INC lists no college codes, so each institution is keyed by a hash of its state, name, city and PIN. M.Sc speciality splits are kept only where they add up to the total INC printed.
